items.title: Korean Air Amex Offer: Get $250 back when spending $2K+ (via Amex Travel™ only)
items.why: Requiring booking through Amex Travel keeps the airline sale in-channel; benchmark this against airline co-brand offer design.
items.summary_ai: Targeted American Express cardholders can get a $250 statement credit on $2,000 of Korean Air spend, booked only through Amex Travel.
items.take: Requiring booking through Amex Travel keeps the airline sale in-channel; benchmark this against airline co-brand offer design.
